summary: SESIÓN 8 (Cálculo SRI correcto) testing complete. 13/13 backend pytest tests PASSED covering /sri/categorias (6 reglas seeded), /sri/deduction-limits new fields (ingresos_gravados_anual / limite_20pct / limite_legal=2784 / limite_efectivo=min), category_progress excluding alimentacion (pct=0) and including sin_tope=true for salud/educacion + tope=850 for vestimenta, IVA logic (aplica_iva=false uses subtotal_sin_iva, aplica_iva=true uses full amount), beneficiario field persistence (yo/conyuge/hijo/padre_madre), PUT updates SESIÓN 8 fields, uso_empresarial regression (excluded from SRI), and SESIÓN 7 /sri/counters regression. Frontend verified: Dashboard sri-deductible-widget shows dynamic text 'Tu límite: $2.784,00 (20% de $42.000,00 = $8.400,00) — Tope legal: $2.784,00' for demo and '(20% de $150.000,00 = $30.000,00)' for admin. Transactions Nueva dialog shows beneficiario-select (Yo mismo default), aplica-iva-toggle (default checked), and subtotal-sin-iva-input only appears when aplica_iva=false (verified toggle behavior).

issues: Pre-existing recharts width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings (cosmetic, also seen in iter17)

passed_tests: GET /api/sri/categorias returns 6 reglas (salud, educacion, alimentacion, vestimenta, turismo, vivienda) with categoria/nombre/porcentaje_deducible/descripcion fields; salud&educacion pct=1.0 sin tope, alimentacion pct=0.0, vestimenta tope=850
GET /api/sri/deduction-limits demo: ingresos_gravados_anual=42000, limite_20pct=8400, limite_legal=2784, limite_efectivo=2784
GET /api/sri/deduction-limits admin: ingresos_gravados_anual=150000, limite_20pct=30000, limite_legal=2784, limite_efectivo=2784
category_progress excludes alimentacion (pct=0); salud/educacion sin_tope=true with limit=null; vestimenta limit=850; turismo/vivienda limit=3868.15
POST /api/transactions with aplica_iva=false + amount=112 + subtotal_sin_iva=100 → total_deductible_spent delta = 100.0 (uses subtotal not total)
POST /api/transactions with aplica_iva=true + amount=112 → delta = 112.0 (uses full amount)
POST /api/transactions persists beneficiario for all 4 valid values (yo, conyuge, hijo, padre_madre)
PUT /api/transactions/{id} updates beneficiario, aplica_iva, subtotal_sin_iva and persists changes
uso_empresarial=true excludes tx from SRI total_deductible_spent (regression SESIÓN 7 OK)
GET /api/sri/counters still returns {con_respaldo, match_aproximado, pendiente_match, sin_vincular} (regression SESIÓN 7 OK)
Frontend Dashboard sri-deductible-widget renders sri-limit-explanation with dynamic text including ingresos, 20pct calc, and tope legal — both for demo (42k → 8400) and admin (150k → 30000)
Frontend progress bar uses limite_efectivo (2784) for percentage calc (verified shows '$200,00 de $2.784,00 máx. — 7%' for demo)
Frontend Transactions Nueva dialog: beneficiario-select default 'Yo mismo' visible; aplica-iva-toggle default checked; subtotal-sin-iva-input HIDDEN when iva=true and APPEARS when toggled off
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.py:_get_ingresos_gravados_anual correctly handles both annual and monthly*12 fallback. Reads personal_budgets.income_projection > get_income_structure(user) fallback (demo=42k, admin=150k). Works.

dashboard.py:_deductible_amount correctly uses subtotal_sin_iva only when aplica_iva is False AND subtotal_sin_iva is truthy; otherwise falls back to amount. Edge case: if user sets aplica_iva=False but forgets subtotal_sin_iva, it falls back to amount (which is the IVA-included total) — minor UX gap, not a bug.
dashboard.py:get_sri_deduction_limits correctly applies pct_deducible per rule from sri_categorias DB. category_progress excludes pct<=0 entries, so alimentacion never appears.
limite_efectivo=min(limite_20pct, limite_legal) when ingresos>0; falls back to limite_legal alone if ingresos=0. Correct.

models.py: TransactionBase has aplica_iva default True (matches PRD) and beneficiario Optional[str] (no enum validation). Backend does not validate beneficiario against BENEFICIARIOS_VALIDOS list — invalid values (e.g., 'mascota') would be persisted. Consider Pydantic validator if strict enum enforcement is desired.
seed_data.py:464 idempotently upserts sri_categorias on startup from SRI_CATEGORIAS_REGLAS. Confirmed 6 docs present.
Frontend Dashboard.js correctly reads sri/deduction-limits and falls back to {limite_legal:2784} on error — graceful degradation. UI text uses Spanish/Ecuador locale formatting ($2.784,00).
Frontend Transactions.js: subtotal-sin-iva-input is conditionally rendered (!formData.aplica_iva) — confirmed UI behavior matches spec.

Beneficiario field is Optional[str] in backend (no enum validator) — frontend uses Select with the 4 valid values, but API would accept any string. category_progress correctly excludes alimentacion (pct=0). The single-tx GET endpoint /api/transactions/{id} does NOT exist (returns 405); use list endpoint with filtering instead.
